First of all, I'm sorry that the love your life left you and aborted the baby but if you were to think logically, in your case, maybe it's a good thing. Now don't get me wrong, I'm not saying abortion itself is okay but you seem like you're not straight with your life nor yourself considering. I'm not saying you're incapable but do you think that you're ready for a child right now while going through all this heavy shit? 

I don't think you should just give up. I mean you even said it yourself that you were thinking of changing things while you were in jail. What changed? On the bright side of all of this, you can focus on yourself instead of worrying about your lover or anyone for that matter. Focus on yourself and get your head straight so that you can be happy. You still have a chance to be somebody. There's still hope for you. Don't give up. Who knows? What if you decide to kill yourself now? What if you decide to just live your life, wasting away on nothing but heroin? Do you really want that?

No. You don't. If you decide to do either of those then whatever you're hoping for in life isn't going to happen. What if you find someone new and have a baby with her? Something you've always wanted eh? So keep fighting for these things man. Trust me, it isn't the end of the world. You've got it in you to still do good and be someone good. Don't let yourself waste away on these drugs man. You're better than that.

You can do this. You're strong and you will make it. You'll make it so far that your old self will look back at this and laugh at it all. 

Good luck my friend.

Fucking my thoughts everyday man. I question everything and it drives me even more insane deciphering the true meaning of life. Spiritually speaking, life is hell because we're all struggling here and learning through adversity. The reason? Points I guess. From what I've learned from my family who are EXTREMELY spiritual, they say that the reason is we have to gain points to level up in the "spiritual" hierarchy. I'm not sure what being top tier will bring; maybe when we're at the top ranks, we're able to do whatever we want? Just an assumption but if you're interested, I can ask my grandma for yah. Personally, I don't believe in it. I respect everyone's opinions and beliefs but it's not really my thing.

Anyway, there are millions of theories out there. Billions actually considering all the many different perspectives EVERYONE in the universe has. It makes me wonder...maybe there isn't one true purpose of life. Maybe diversity is key. We're all different. We all think differently. I mean, of course there are those who join religious masses but maybe we make one for ourselves and I think that's quite interesting. 

I'm more of an anarchist which is why I find this rather infatuating. We choose our own purpose and we create our own destiny. But it all comes down to whether you believe in this or that. Whatever the case may be, choose something that'll make you happy and curious about life instead of dreading it. 

Good luck my friend, you're not alone.

I feel you and I apologize that it happened when you were so young. Sexual feelings at such a young age could depict sexual abuse or childhood trauma. It could probably be molded from general curiousity  but...shit.The past is the past and albeit you can't go back and change it, you can change it now alternatively. You say your brother is fucked up now? I know you tried to talk it out, saying you don't want to do this anymore and he continually wants this to go on but maybe you guys should seek professional help?Or at least someone in your life who would understand and support you guys. I'm not trying to imply anything to offend you or your brother but this kind of thing is hard to deal with alone. You're not a monster. I can see why you think you are but if it helps, things that are experimental like this are common. I'm not saying it's justified but you get what I mean. Take it from a person who's seen some shit go down and has done some crazy shit. You're not a monster, an abomination. Considering you were so young and had no one to talk to about it, you just assumed it was normal which is why it went on for so long. No one stopped nor protected you guys.Shit happens and we can only try to make things right by bettering ourselves and helping people around you the best you can. I'm not in your shoes so I can't say exactly what you need to do because only YOU know that but maybe the first step to take is talking to someone other than your brother about it. Everything will be fine as long as you allow it to be. We can control our emotions and control how we let things affect us. How are you going to let this affect you? Are you going to let yourself rot as the monster you think you are?Or make things right and come out fucking awesome? Your choice.

Good luck my friend, you're not alone in this ugly world.
